lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 10 distinct high-contrast vertical white lines; spacing is relatively uniform across the mid-torso, approximately 50-70 pixels between lines, with decreasing intervals toward the posterior.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Anterior lines 1-3 terminate mid-torso; posterior lines 8-10 terminate before the ventral boundary, transitioning into fragmented spot patterns.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of approximately 8 high-contrast spots is located on the lower posterior haunch and upper hind limb region.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: A horizontal alignment of three spots is visible on the central portion of the lateral haunch.

other_distinctive_markers: Two distinct white spots on the cheek/zygomatic region; prominent white chevron markings on the muzzle; white patch on the lower neck; white bands on the lower limbs above the hooves.
